name: Employee-driving_license_number
label: Driving License Number
description: Only relevant for employees who drive company trucks.

name: Employee-driving_license_expiry_date
label: Driving License Expiry Date
description: Tracked by the daily compliance-expiry check (Transport Logistics Settings) and verified on every Authority to Load for a trip this employee is driving.

name: Employee-port_pass_number
label: Port Pass Number
description: Only relevant for employees who need port authority (e.g. KPA) access to operate at the port.

name: Employee-port_pass_expiry_date
label: Port Pass Expiry Date
description: Tracked by the daily compliance-expiry check (Transport Logistics Settings) and verified on every Authority to Load for a driver who has a Port Pass Number on file (not dependent on the trip's destination).
